anatomy.title: Short ciliary nerve · Source anatomy · draft
anatomy.body: This source-defined bilateral group supplies one original mesh file on each side. Use the laterality filter to inspect either file beside the available ganglion and orbital context; Both sides restores the complete source group.
bullets: One unsided FMA identity is retained. Display-side metadata does not create separately validated left/right anatomical concepts.
Each file contains two topological components; visible projections and connected components do not establish normal nerve count or a complete ocular autonomic pathway.
Reassemble before comparing relationships. Near contact does not prove fibre continuity, precise globe entry, an operative plane or patient correspondence.
anatomy.note: Original-source orientation draft; revision-bound radiologist review required.
